axis: senselessness treated indulgently → senselessness condemned as madness

members.tone: Weighty and censorious - it treats the behaviour as a failure of judgement grave enough to be named, where *craziness* simply calls it mad.
The softest way of naming senseless behaviour here, framing it as something permitted or allowed oneself rather than something to be condemned.
The hardest word in the set - it does not call the behaviour unwise but insane, and means the charge to land.
Plain and unbuttoned beside the grander *lunacy*, making the same accusation of madness without the formality.
Aimed at clowning and buffoonery - antic performance rather than the misjudgement *folly* names, so the disapproval comes with amusement in it.
